arabic text: AL-MADAD BABA, AL-MADAD BABA\nJALTE DARWAAZE KE NEECHE HAI TUMHAARI ZAHRA
english translation text: HELP, O FATHER! HELP, O FATHER!\nBENEATH THE BURNING DOOR LIES YOUR ZAHRA (AS)

arabic text: MAIN GIRI KHAAK PE, DARWAAZA GIRA HAI MUJH PAR\nGHAR MEIN DAAKHIL HUWI UMMAT YEH USI PE CHAL KAR\nPASLIYAAN TOOT KE DETI HI RAHIN TUM KO SADAA
english translation text: I FELL TO THE DUST, AND THE DOOR FELL UPON ME\nTHIS UMMAH ENTERED THE HOUSE BY WALKING OVER THAT VERY DOOR\nAS THEY BROKE, MY RIBS KEPT CALLING OUT TO YOU

arabic text: AL-MADAD BABA, AL-MADAD BABA\nJALTE DARWAAZE KE NEECHE HAI TUMHAARI ZAHRA
english translation text: HELP, O FATHER! HELP, O FATHER!\nBENEATH THE BURNING DOOR LIES YOUR ZAHRA (AS)

arabic text: APNI HAALAT MEIN ALI SE BHI NAHIN KEH SAKTI\nITNI ZAKHMI HOON KE ZINDA BHI NAHIN REH SAKTI\nHAR GHADI KHOON MEIN TAR REHTI HAI AB MERI RIDA
english translation text: I CANNOT TELL MY CONDITION EVEN TO ALI (AS)\nI AM SO WOUNDED THAT I CANNOT EVEN STAY ALIVE\nNOW, EVERY MOMENT, MY VEIL STAYS SOAKED IN BLOOD

arabic text: AL-MADAD BABA, AL-MADAD BABA\nJALTE DARWAAZE KE NEECHE HAI TUMHAARI ZAHRA
english translation text: HELP, O FATHER! HELP, O FATHER!\nBENEATH THE BURNING DOOR LIES YOUR ZAHRA (AS)

arabic text: KYUN NAHIN AATE BHALA, AAP KAHAAN HAIN BABA\nDEKHO CHEHRE PE TAMAACHON KE NISHAAN HAIN BABA\nMAINE ZAINAB SE CHHUPAAYA HAI YEH ZAKHMI CHEHRA
english translation text: WHY DO YOU NOT COME? WHERE ARE YOU, FATHER?\nLOOK, THERE ARE MARKS OF SLAPS ON MY FACE, FATHER\nI HAVE HIDDEN THIS WOUNDED FACE FROM ZAINAB (SA)

arabic text: AL-MADAD BABA, AL-MADAD BABA\nJALTE DARWAAZE KE NEECHE HAI TUMHAARI ZAHRA
english translation text: HELP, O FATHER! HELP, O FATHER!\nBENEATH THE BURNING DOOR LIES YOUR ZAHRA (AS)

arabic text: MUJH SE DARBAAR NE EK DIN MEIN JAWAANI CHHEENI\nGHAR TALAK BHI HOON MAIN BETON KE SAHAARE AAYI\nHAAL ATHAARAH BARAS MEIN HAI ZAEEFA JAISA
english translation text: IN A SINGLE DAY, THE COURT TOOK MY YOUTH FROM ME\nEVEN TO GET HOME, I CAME LEANING ON MY SONS\nAT EIGHTEEN YEARS OLD, MY STATE IS LIKE AN OLD WOMAN'S

arabic text: AL-MADAD BABA, AL-MADAD BABA\nJALTE DARWAAZE KE NEECHE HAI TUMHAARI ZAHRA
english translation text: HELP, O FATHER! HELP, O FATHER!\nBENEATH THE BURNING DOOR LIES YOUR ZAHRA (AS)

arabic text: KEEL PAIWAST JO PEHLU MEIN HUWI HAI MERE\nUS LIYE BABA MERE HAATH NAHIN UTH SAKTE\nKUCH NAHIN MAANGNA, BAS MAUT KI KARNI HAI DUA
english translation text: BECAUSE OF THE NAIL THAT HAS PIERCED MY SIDE,\nFATHER, I CANNOT RAISE MY HANDS\nI ASK FOR NOTHING; I ONLY HAVE TO PRAY FOR DEATH

arabic text: AL-MADAD BABA, AL-MADAD BABA\nJALTE DARWAAZE KE NEECHE HAI TUMHAARI ZAHRA
english translation text: HELP, O FATHER! HELP, O FATHER!\nBENEATH THE BURNING DOOR LIES YOUR ZAHRA (AS)

arabic text: KAM QAYAAMAT SE NAHIN HAI YEH AJAB DIN BABA\nMUJH MEIN HI DAFN HUWA HAI MERA MOHSIN BABA\nSAARE ZAKHMON SE HAI MERE, YAHI EK ZAKHM BADA
english translation text: THIS STRANGE DAY IS NO LESS THAN QAYAMAT, FATHER\nMY MOHSIN (AS) IS BURIED WITHIN ME, FATHER\nOF ALL MY WOUNDS, THIS ONE WOUND IS THE GREATEST

arabic text: AL-MADAD BABA, AL-MADAD BABA\nJALTE DARWAAZE KE NEECHE HAI TUMHAARI ZAHRA
english translation text: HELP, O FATHER! HELP, O FATHER!\nBENEATH THE BURNING DOOR LIES YOUR ZAHRA (AS)

arabic text: AB BHI AZLAAN BAQEE'AH SE SADAA AATI HAI\nPASLIYAAN TOOTI THEEN KAL, AAJ LAHAD TOOTI HAI\nJAANE KIS BAAT KI DI AHL-E-MADINAH NE SAZA
english translation text: EVEN NOW, AZLAAN, A CRY COMES FROM AL-BAQI\nYESTERDAY THE RIBS WERE BROKEN; TODAY THE GRAVE IS BROKEN\nWHO KNOWS FOR WHAT THE PEOPLE OF MADINAH GAVE THIS PUNISHMENT

arabic text: AL-MADAD BABA, AL-MADAD BABA\nJALTE DARWAAZE KE NEECHE HAI TUMHAARI ZAHRA
english translation text: HELP, O FATHER! HELP, O FATHER!\nBENEATH THE BURNING DOOR LIES YOUR ZAHRA (AS)
